explanation: Choose each possible next value by swapping it into the next fixed position. Recursively permute the suffix and undo the swap on return; copy each completed arrangement.
timeComplexity: O(n n!) time including output copying.
spaceComplexity: O(n) copied working array and recursion space, plus output.
